propositions: P10 verification-presence is a new blocking deterministic check that requires leaf plans to have a Testing/Verification section, or at least one AC item with backtick-fenced code or matching verification vocabulary (pytest, test_*, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked:, verif*, exit code).

P11 ac-vagueness is a new blocking deterministic check with a fixed lexicon including word boundaries on both sides; 'clean' is removed and 'etc.' is retained with 30-character span-proximity exemption.
The fixed P11 lexicon is scanned only over AC item lines with inline code-span positions recorded on the original line before spans are blanked; lexicon hits inside recorded spans do not fire.
P6 ac-quality remains advisory and is updated to share the fixed P11 lexicon matcher so both surfaces agree.

Backtests over 304 passed plans and 55 blocked-plan hits showed zero false positives with the boundary-fixed lexicon and verified all four verification-presence marginal FPs overlapped real blocking findings.
